verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is a sales-tax compliance SaaS that holds customer transaction data, so an AI-training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents no such policy or control. The MCP server note that it only reads public docs and never sees credentials concerns credential exposure, not model training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
